purpose: 8 GB DiffEdit automatic-mask repeat study; fixed P7-5.2 input, not a P7-5.3 production cut
source_prompt: one adult woman with a teal bob haircut, dark gray crop top, teal wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, standing front-facing in a plain studio

runs.target_prompt: one adult woman with a teal bob haircut, cropped white jacket worn open over a dark gray crop top, teal wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, standing front-facing in a plain studio
runs.result: mask spreads across the body and floor; output changes face, hair, clothing, and shoes.

runs.target_prompt: one adult woman with a teal bob haircut, cropped white jacket worn open over a dark gray crop top, teal wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, standing front-facing in a plain studio
runs.result: mask becomes sparse and misses the jacket; output leaves the requested clothing unchanged while altering small unrelated areas.

runs.target_prompt: one adult woman with a teal bob haircut, cropped white jacket, teal wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, standing front-facing in a plain studio
runs.result: single-clothing target still spreads to face, lower body, and shoes; output produces garment and belt artifacts instead of a white cropped jacket.

runs.target_prompt: one adult woman with a teal bob haircut, cropped white jacket worn open over a dark gray crop top, teal wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, standing front-facing in a plain studio
runs.result: mask re-expands to the head, torso, lower body, and shoes; output misses the jacket and adds small clothing and shoe artifacts.

decision: No tested configuration isolates the requested jacket or preserves the non-edited regions. DiffEdit is excluded from the production path and retained only as a failed automatic-mask baseline.
next_action: Do not increase steps or continue prompt sweeps. Compare a manually limited mask only after a P7-5.3 full-frame panel passes.
